case.summary: Customer C08106 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $128.33 (txn 3583227) on card C08106-K1. Investigation confirmed the charge was initiated from a new device (D001477) with no prior transaction history for this holder profile. Card C08106-K1 also carries three prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases (CC-1736, CC-2121, and CC-3778) and sits in a community with an elevated fraud lift of 9.9. In the absence of recurring billing or positive evidence of authorization, the activity is ruled card_not_present_new_device fraud. The card has been blocked and a case opened for dispute processing.
